subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should CodexBar support this as a narrowly documented OpenCode/OpenCode Go recovery command now, or first establish a consistent refresh contract for the broader set of cookie-backed providers described in the linked request?
rationale: The implementation is a new public CLI/auth-provider behavior rather than a repair to an existing documented command, and the linked issue explicitly raises broader provider coverage and command-shape choices that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Sponsor narrow provider scope
options.body: Document and test `cookie refresh` as an OpenCode/OpenCode Go-only recovery command, with unsupported providers retaining their existing automatic recovery path.

options.title: Design a shared provider contract first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define which cookie-backed providers can safely support explicit refresh and how unsupported providers should report fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow provider scope
recommendation.body: Document and test `cookie refresh` as an OpenCode/OpenCode Go-only recovery command, with unsupported providers retaining their existing automatic recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available repository and commit metadata point to steipete for the CLI/release surface and the requested public-command direction.
